text: Coffee with Tunde after the all-hands. His manager Bruno is leaving end of the month and nobody knows who's replacing him. Tunde's quietly hoping it's him. Should ask him how the conversation with HR went sometime next week. He's also mentoring the two new grads, Mila and Sam, and says Sam is the sharper of the two but never speaks in meetings.
Amara's dad passed away on Saturday. Funeral is Thursday, October 29th at St Brendan's. Need to send flowers to her mum's house before then.

Long call with Finn. He and Phoebe split up in the summer and he's only now properly talking about it. Moved into a flatshare in Leith. Still plays five-a-side Tuesdays, which seems to be keeping him sane. Phoebe kept the flat and the dog. He says he's not ready to date but his sister keeps setting him up anyway. Should get him out for a pint before he goes home for Christmas.
Dry cleaning ready Thursday. Car MOT due end of November.
Erin got made redundant this morning, along with half the design team. She's okay-ish, more angry than sad. Her consultation meeting is November 4. Remind me to check in on her over the weekend.
Kenji says the client in Osaka wants the deck by 11/6 now, not mid-November. Colm is not happy. I'm doing the slides for section two regardless.
Bogdan's leaving do was meant to be Friday but it's been called off, his last day got pushed into early December. He's off to Lisbon for a week before the new job starts.

Catch-up with Aditi. Her nan died a couple of weeks ago, back in Kolkata, and she couldn't fly out in time. Really struggling with that. Her husband Arjun has taken over most of the school runs. I should take her out for lunch sometime next week, somewhere quiet. Amara sent round a sympathy card for everyone to sign too.
Naledi starting at Deloitte on January 12th. Nervous about the commute more than the job.
Karim and Mila got engaged in Rome!! Wedding probably over the summer, maybe late August. Mila wants a tiny one, Karim's mum wants two hundred guests. Good luck with that.
Mila mentioned Karim keeps eyeing those Japanese chef knives, a decent one would make a good engagement present.
Yaw's performance review is November 18th. His new boss, Mrs Brennan, is apparently a nightmare about metrics. He's prepping a whole spreadsheet of wins. Don't forget to message him the night before.
Renew passport!! Expires 3/2 and I'm flying in early March. Book the photo booth at Boots this week.

Aoife rang. Her grandad's funeral is in Galway on the 24th, she's driving over with her brother Eamon on Thursday. She sounded wrecked. Text her Saturday to see how it went. Eamon's taking it worse than she is, apparently, he was very close to him. Their grandad was the one who taught them both to sail.

Giulia Bianchi from the agency side said their contract renewal goes to procurement sometime in November. She's on leave from December 14 to January 5, so we need sign-off before that. Omar wants a call with her first week of December.
Efua's cat Biscuit had to be put to sleep yesterday. Sixteen years old. She's gutted.

Dinner at Agnieszka and Chris's. They're moving to Gdansk in the spring, Chris got a transfer with his firm. Their kids are already learning Polish off YouTube. Agnieszka's mum is thrilled. Need to get them a proper leaving present before March. Chris starts out there on April 1st, and Agnieszka will follow with the kids once the school term ends in late June.
Fern hates surprise parties, note for her 40th on June 3rd.
Eamon says his divorce finally went through last week. Seemed lighter, honestly. He's taking the kids to Center Parcs over half term.
Blessing's mum has a hip replacement on November 12. Blessing is flying back to Lagos the week after to help with recovery, staying until mid-December. Ask her how the op went.

Francesca was in a state at standup. The Hendrick client pulled the account and she thinks her team's next. Sam reckons restructure announcements come out end of the month. Nothing I can do but should grab her a coffee tomorrow. She told me Sam has already been offered voluntary redundancy and is weighing it up. Honestly the whole floor feels jumpy.
Groceries, bin day moved to Wednesday, and call the boiler guy about the service on the 28th.
Nia's mum passed in August. She told me today, I had no idea. Back at work but on a phased return till Christmas. She's into pottery now, said it helps.
Imogen is pregnant! Due 5/14. Her partner Kwame is already building a cot from scratch, obviously.

Lena didn't get the head of ops role, it went to someone external. She's applying elsewhere and has an interview at Ocado on Nov 9. Pretty nervous about it. Remind me to text her good luck that morning.
Chat with Arjun at the station. He's coeliac, so no bakery stuff for the team thing. Supports Leicester, has a dog called Pickle.
Tunde's sister Blessing graduates from her nursing degree July 21st. Whole family is going up to Manchester.
Note to self: I'm taking Friday the 13th off, and the whole week of Christmas. Need to get the annual leave form in before Bruno leaves.
Kenji's wife Yuki had a baby girl on Sunday! Both doing well. He's off for paternity until sometime in December. Colm is organising a card, put money in by Friday.
Phoebe got the promotion to senior associate. Starts the new role after the Christmas break. Send congrats.
Omar says the Bianchi account review is moved to 12/2. Kwame will present, I'm doing the numbers.

Phone call with Colm, about an hour. His dad has been diagnosed with early-stage Parkinson's and Colm's been driving up to Belfast every other weekend. He's thinking of asking for compressed hours. His girlfriend Fern is being amazing about it. I said I'd cover his Friday clients if it comes to that. Check in with him sometime next week, and maybe ask Bruno quietly whether compressed hours are even on the table before he leaves on the 30th.
Finn passed his driving test!! Third try.
Agnieszka recommended a Polish deli on Leith Walk, try it this weekend.
Bogdan Wang (Bogs) from finance says the budget freeze lifts in early January. Then hiring reopens.
Aoife and Eamon's mum turns 70 on April 8. They're planning a surprise in Kinsale. I've been asked to keep that weekend free.
Amara back at work today, two weeks after the funeral. She said people keep avoiding her in the kitchen. Make a point of having lunch with her Thursday.
Sorted the spare room, donated three bags to the charity shop. Still need to return the lamp to IKEA before 11/15.

Giulia's partner left her last month, totally out of the blue. She's staying with her sister in Bologna over Christmas. Her birthday is December 18, I should send something small, she loves those Ottolenghi books.
Met the new client lead, Mr Nguyen. Very formal, wants weekly updates every Monday. Chris is account manager on it now.

Yaw's been off sick with long covid since September. He messaged to say he's hoping to be back sometime in the new year. Don't want to pester him but must send him something by the end of the week. Omar knows him from a previous job and says he's fair but expects everything in writing. First steering meeting is November 16th.
Efua and her husband Sam are doing the London marathon in late April, raising money for the hospice that looked after her dad. Sponsor them.
Erin had an interview with Monzo yesterday, thinks it went well. Hears back early next week. Find out how it went.

Lunch with Naledi, Kwame and Imogen. Naledi's last day is December 19, she's starting the Deloitte job after New Year. Kwame's planning leaving drinks. Imogen's twelve weeks in, morning sickness horrendous. Kwame says they might move closer to her parents in Reading over the summer.
Pick up prescription. Pay council tax before the 1st.
Karim's grandmother died on Monday. He's flying to Amman tomorrow and will be gone at least ten days. I said I'd water his plants. Need to get his spare key from Mila.
Francesca's team is safe, restructure only hit sales. She was hugely relieved. Her daughter Mila starts primary school in September and she's been touring schools.
Tunde's on the hiring panel for Bruno's replacement, interviews 11/23 to 11/25.
Kenji mentioned his manager Dr Banerjee is retiring at the end of the academic year, so July-ish. He's going for her job.
Booked the dentist for June 3rd at 9:20. Also need to sort a vet check for the dog sometime next month.
Phoebe told me Finn's been seeing someone new, Lena from the climbing wall. Didn't say much more. Phoebe seemed fine about it, they're properly over.
Chris and Agnieszka's farewell party is March 14, at their place. They're asking for no presents but Agnieszka hinted that a good bottle of Tokaji wouldn't hurt.
Bruno's last day is officially Friday the 30th. Drinks at the Cumberland Arms from 5. Card is going round, sign it before Thursday.

Aditi said Arjun lost his job at the bank last week. He's handling it better than she is. They're cutting back, cancelled their trip to Goa in February. She's worried about the mortgage. Call her this weekend.
Imogen's scan went fine, everything normal. She found out it's a boy but isn't telling anyone yet. Mila's going with him for the first few days, then coming back for work.
Uncle Kwame's memorial is on the anniversary, November 10. Mum wants me to drive her down the night before.
Amara asked if I knew anyone hiring. Her contract ends end of January and they've said they won't renew. She's brilliant at data viz, I should ping Omar about the analyst role.
Nothing much. Rained all day, worked from home, finished the quarterly report.
Erin got the Monzo job! Starts mid-November. Her ex-boss Giulia even wrote her a reference.

Coffee with Blessing and her brother Yaw. Yaw's back at work part time from November 2nd, three days a week. Blessing's off to Lagos on 11/19 for her mum's recovery. Their dog Bisi is staying with me for the fortnight, so I need dog food and a lead.
